answer: Name: Mesa-vertex signal aging. Each agent periodically publishes a tiny signed signal as a new vertex in a shared DAG; transaction fees scale as 1/(1+age), where age is time since that agent’s oldest unbroken vertex chain. Honest agents accrue cheap capacity. A clone starts at zero age, so it pays the full mesa fee on every action until it waits long enough to age in; creating many clones multiplies both waiting time and fee drag.
